title: $2M Sale
blurb: A UK collector sold Pokémon cards for over $2 million, reportedly a UK record.
quip: Some binders are worth more than houses.

title: Set Alert
blurb: The Deck Crafter's Collection is out now, packed with competitive staples, and Lorcana heads to Disney Cruise Line ships in 2027.
quip: New staples. Same old shuffle face.

title: Deck Crafter's
blurb: The Deck Crafter's Collection is out now, and Lorcana heads to Disney Cruise Line ships in 2027.
quip: Staples in the box. Sea legs in 2027.

title: Mihawk Banned
blurb: OP14-020 Dracule Mihawk is banned, alternate arts included, and now in effect.
source: Official One Piece Card Game site
quip: Sheathe the swords. Rebuild the deck.

title: Doug's Collection
blurb: Items from Doug Ferguson's Pokémon collection go to auction on November 3.
quip: Somebody's grail is about to change addresses.

title: Chorus of Steel
blurb: Smash Palace arrives October 30, bringing back Ultimate Pit Fight with two new heroes.
quip: Bring a friend. Then flatten them, lovingly.

title: Into the Inkdark
blurb: Preorders are open, with release expected February 12, 2027 and the first serialized Illustrious cards.
quip: Ink now, brag in February.

title: Fracture Delayed
blurb: The Reality Fracture Secret Lair Bundle is delayed by shipping and production issues, after the Star Trek Commander Decks slipped first.
quip: Good things come to those who refresh the tracking page.

title: Dual Fusion
blurb: Dual Fusion is out in Pokémon TCG Pocket, debuting dual-type cards led by Mega Mewtwo X ex and Mega Greninja ex.
quip: Two types, one pack, zero chill.

title: Superdrop
blurb: Set Phasers to Superdrop brings five Star Trek Secret Lair drops, with preorders opening November 9.
quip: Beam up your wallet.

title: $4.88M Mudkip
blurb: Goldin's Pokémon 30th Anniversary auction passed $28 million, led by a PSA 10 Art Academy Mudkip promo at $4.88 million.
quip: Mudkip just outbid your rent.

title: Release Radar
blurb: A packed release radar: Magic's Star Trek set on Nov 13, One Piece Heroines Edition Vol. 2 and OP-18, and more dates for your wallet.
quip: Save this. Your wallet already did.

title: Star Trek Timeline
blurb: The complete Magic x Star Trek timeline, with every date you need for the release.
quip: Boldly going where your budget hasn't.

title: $600M Quarter
blurb: Magic crossed $600 million in one quarter for Hasbro, while the Reality Fracture Secret Lair bundle slipped past Oct 23.
quip: Big numbers, late bundles.

title: Launch Day
blurb: Riftbound's 5th set Radiance, with 9 new Legends, and Lorcana's Hyperia City (feat. Coco) both drop this Friday.
quip: So many shiny new cards. So few dollars.

title: Banlist Shock
blurb: After YCS Houston, Konami's new list hits 34 Forbidden and 8 Limited, with Called by the Grave leading the charge.
quip: Deckboxes were opened. Tears were shed.

title: Delta Reign
blurb: Delta Reign is headlined by Mega Rayquaza EX, with prereleases from Oct 24 and full release on Nov 6.
quip: Zia held the desk solo. Rayquaza held the spotlight.

title: 2.8 Billion Cards
blurb: Disney Lorcana marks 3 years and 2.8 billion cards sold with a Beauty and the Beast collection, plus Mega Mewtwo X EX in TCG Pocket.
quip: Tale as old as time, print run as big as ever.

title: Robin Manga Rare
blurb: One Piece OP-18 brings Nico Robin's first Manga Rare and Yoshitaka Amano Secret Rares, plus Star Wars: Unlimited HomeWorld and Pokémon's ex Star tease.
quip: Art collectors, hide your wallets.

title: Face Scan Check-in
blurb: Bandai says face recognition check-in is coming to the TCG Plus app, plus Fusion World's Brightness of Hope and Union Arena's Arknights drop.
quip: Smile, you're registered for the tournament.
